01 /

Find your fixture

Browse the sports and competitions currently published on EDGE. Each event shows its participants, start time, available odds and status. The fixture list changes as administrators publish and update games.

  • Open games accept stakes before their scheduled start.
  • Live, suspended, finished and void games do not accept new stakes.
02 /

One pick. Or a bigger picture.

A single stake follows one selection. A multiple combines selections from different games into one stake. Review the amount and potential return in your slip before confirming.

  • Decimal odds show the total return multiplier, including your stake.
  • Accepted stakes keep the odds recorded when they were placed.
  • If a quote changes before submission, refresh and review the new odds.
03 /

The final score tells the story

Administrators enter final scores after games end. EDGE uses the recorded outcome to settle accepted stakes and credit winning returns. A void single is refunded; a void selection in a multiple contributes a multiplier of 1.00.

04 /

Keep every result in view

My stakes shows pending and settled selections. Your wallet history records the associated movements, so you can follow both the game and its effect on your balance.
